## Summary

Describe the change and the learner or maintainer problem it addresses.

## Type of change

- [ ] New content
- [ ] Content correction
- [ ] Translation
- [ ] Registry or schema change
- [ ] Tooling or automation
- [ ] Website
- [ ] Documentation / governance

## Quality checklist

- [ ] I searched for existing content and stable IDs.
- [ ] I added or updated authoritative sources.
- [ ] I stated version scope where relevant.
- [ ] I used the applicable content template and schema.
- [ ] I checked translation status and terminology where relevant.
- [ ] I tested code examples or explained why testing is not applicable.
- [ ] I checked links and local paths.
- [ ] I did not copy third-party material without verified reuse permission.
- [ ] I have not claimed review or verification that has not occurred.

## Additional context

Link related issues and note known limitations.
